allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Electrotherm (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 1,09,50,000 6% Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares of Rs. 10/- each, to the existing preference shareholders pursuant to to Hon ble NCLT Order dated 21st July, 2026 and in accordance with the provisions of Section 55(3) of the Companies Act, 2013.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Electrotherm (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update - NCLT Order - Issuance and allotment of Preference Shares under Section 55(3) of the Companies Act, 2013'.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Electrotherm (India) Limited has informed that the Board inter aila has considered and approved proposal for issuance and allotment of further 1,20,00,000   6% Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares ( NCRPS ) of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, in one or more tranches, pursuant to Section 55(3) of the Companies Act, 2013, to the existing NCRPS holders, of amount equivalent to the amount of unredeemed Preference Shares of Rs. 12,00,00,000/- (Rupees Twelve Crore only), subject to requisite approval of majority holders of preference shares and the National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Ben
